hook_en: He is your sun and your shield. 🙏
reflect_en: The psalmist describes the LORD God as a sun that gives light and a shield that protects, and he says God withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity. Whatever you're facing this Thursday, you can keep walking faithfully and trust Him with the rest.
q_en: Where do you need God to be your shield today?
x_en: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
tiktok: He is your sun and your shield 🙏 Psalm 84:11–12 — He withholds no good thing
yt_title: The LORD God Is a Sun and a Shield | Psalm 84:11–12 #Shorts
li_open: Integrity is rarely rewarded on the timeline we expect.
li_quote: the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
li_body: The psalmist trusted that God withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity, even when the results aren't visible yet. Leaders who keep doing what is right, and keep praying faithfully for the people in their care, can rest in the God who is both their light and their protection.
hook_es: Él es tu sol y tu escudo. 🙏
reflect_es: El salmista declara que sol y escudo es Jehová Dios: Él alumbra tu camino y te protege, y no quitará el bien a los que en integridad andan. Sea lo que sea que enfrentes este jueves, puedes seguir caminando con fidelidad y confiarle a Él todo lo demás.
q_es: ¿En qué área de tu vida necesitas que Dios sea tu escudo hoy?
x_es: Porque sol y escudo es Jehová Dios: gracia y gloria dará Jehová: no quitará el bien a los que en integridad andan.
key_es: sol y escudo es Jehová Dios
